summary: PTY registry reconciliation now finalizes durable producer ownership even after an applied start has left the pending-start cleanup path. Server records capture PID generation and boot identity; a vanished or reused generation is closed only after its work and server scopes are also proven closed. Closure records include a typed reason and publication_pending=false, allowing ended producers to be reclaimed without treating registry absence as proof.

schema.detail: Native PTY sidecars now record server identity and typed closure metadata; no database schema changes.

rules.detail: Live, inaccessible, malformed, partial, or boot-ambiguous server evidence cannot authorize generation-based closure.

compatibility.detail: Existing scope-only server records retain scope-based closure; they never authorize PID-generation closure.

downtime.detail: Takes effect after restart on the updated runtime.

manual.detail: No manual changes to producer directories are required.

recovery.detail: Closure is durable and conservative; ambiguous producer directories remain pending.
